statement: Build a one-page, mobile-first website for Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, showing the menu with prices, opening hours, location, a pre-order for pickup, and a video of coffee being brewed that loads only when a visitor taps it.
audience: Local coffee drinkers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, mostly on phones, who want to check the menu, hours and location, watch the brew, and order ahead for pickup.
standards: Fast on a phone: speed matters more than visuals.
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step.
Readable and usable on a small screen without zooming.
Any fact not supplied by the Requester appears as a clearly marked placeholder, never invented.
rules: Speed outranks visuals wherever the two conflict.
Nothing heavy loads on first view: no autoplay media, no large assets, no video data fetched until a visitor taps play.
The brew video is kept in scope only as a tap-to-play element (full-screen on play is allowed), because an autoplaying full-screen background would break the speed rule.
No invented prices, hours, address, phone numbers, photos or video files.
done_when: The site is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JS, with no build step; any CDN library is optional and not needed for first render.
The file contains a viewport meta tag and a layout that adapts to phone widths.
The file has a menu section listing items with a price shown for every item (real or marked placeholder).
The file has an hours section covering the days of the week (real or marked placeholder).
The file has a location section naming Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with an address and a map or directions link (real or marked placeholder).
The file has a pre-order for pickup section where a visitor can pick items, enter a name and a pickup time, and send the order to a stated destination (real or marked placeholder).

The file has a brew video section with a play control and a video element that has preload="none", no autoplay attribute, and no source URL set until the play control is tapped; the video source is a marked placeholder.
The file loads no video and starts no autoplay media on page load.
Any images are lazy-loaded and sized; no external fonts or scripts block first render.
Every placeholder is visibly marked as a placeholder in the page text.
open_inputs: Pre-order destination (for example a WhatsApp or phone number) and pickup time rules
Brew video file or link (short and compressed), and a poster image if wanted
